QUOTE: `AppDataOperator` (`app/database/operator/app_data_operator/index.ts`) extends the same `BaseDataOperator`, so it gets the same `processRecords`, `prepareRecords`, `batchRecords` and `handleRecords`. It runs against the global app database, not a server database.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names AppDataOperator as another BaseDataOperator subclass sharing the write path (batchRecords) and operating on the app-level database.
